name: Adapt
summary: Gains resistance to the last element that hit this unit.

name: Barrier
summary: Absorbs magic damage only.

name: Berserk
summary: Damage +30%, but DR reduced by 5.

name: Bleed
summary: Takes physical damage each turn. Worse when moving.

name: Blind
summary: Accuracy reduced by 50%. Fishing/quickpress QTE harder.

name: Burn
summary: Takes fire damage each turn.

name: Charm
summary: Attacks own allies instead of enemies. Breaks if ally damages you.

name: Clumsy
summary: Agility reduced.

name: Confuse
summary: Actions target randomly (friend or foe).

name: Corrode
summary: Takes damage each turn. Reduces DR by 2 per stack.

name: Counter Stance
summary: Automatically counter-attacks when hit.

name: Curse
summary: Takes dark damage each turn. Cannot be healed.

name: Doom
summary: Dies when duration expires. Can be cleansed.

name: Dull
summary: Intelligence reduced.

name: Exposed
summary: All DR reduced by 5.

name: Fear
summary: Must move away from the source. Cannot attack the source.

name: Focus
summary: Next attack has +50% crit chance.

name: Fragile
summary: Endurance and DR reduced.

name: Freeze
summary: Cannot act or move. Takes 50% extra from Fire.

name: Frostbite
summary: Takes water damage each turn. Slows movement by 1.

name: Haste
summary: Movement +2, Agility +3.

name: Immobilize
summary: Cannot move. Same as Root but doesn't break.

name: Link
summary: Damage taken is split between linked units.

name: Mark
summary: Marked target takes bonus damage from the marker.

name: Petrify
summary: Cannot act or move. +10 Physical DR while petrified.

name: Poison
summary: Takes nature damage each turn. Stacks.

name: Protect
summary: Redirects attacks from adjacent allies to self.

name: Regen
summary: Heals HP each turn.

name: Root
summary: Cannot move. Can still attack and use skills.

name: Shield
summary: Absorbs damage before HP. Shield has its own HP pool that depletes.

name: Shock
summary: Takes lightning damage each turn. QTE difficulty +1.

name: Silence
summary: Cannot use skills (only basic attack/move/defend). Quiz QTE auto-fails.

name: Sleep
summary: Cannot act or move. BREAKS when taking damage.

name: Slow
summary: Movement reduced by 2.

name: Stealth
summary: Cannot be targeted. Breaks on attacking or taking AoE damage.

name: Stun
summary: Cannot act or move. Does NOT break on damage.

name: Taunt
summary: Must target the taunter with attacks.

name: Transform
summary: Changed into another form. Stats replaced temporarily.

name: Unlucky
summary: Luck reduced. Crit chance down.

name: Weakness
summary: Strength reduced.

name: Web
summary: Cannot move. Breaks on taking fire damage.

name: Storm Surge
summary: Charged with storm energy. +20% damage while Rain or Blizzard is active.

name: Wet
summary: Soaked through. +25% damage taken from Lightning. Rain extends this.

name: Negate Next Damage
summary: Next incoming damage instance is fully negated.
